missing.why: Zadok is named as one of the sons of Eleazar, and no row joins him to Eleazar.
Beno is listed under 'the sons of Merari by Jaaziah', but only his son-of-Jaaziah row exists.
Shubael is given as 'of the sons of Amram', and the site identifies Shubael with Shebuel (see the jehdeiah record), so the line Amram, Moses, Gershom, Shebuel supports this, though no row records it.

note: No row is contradicted: all 46 fit the text, and the owner rows (the 24 course priests, plus jedaiah-3 and jehoiarib-2 as descendant-of aaron) match v.19 'under Aaron their father'. Sibling pairs that follow only from shared-father lists (Aaron's four sons in v.1, Hebron's sons in v.23, Mushi's sons in v.30) are left out as inferences, though the site records some of them.
